items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It sounds like you liked playing in the Hampton band... Come on, Gates. Play this with me.

ctx.x: Used some of the same things. It sounds like you liked playing in the Hampton band, but you might have found his leadership problematic.

What I found was what he could have accomplished was somewhat hindered by his, “I want to be in the spotlight all the time.” Distractions. Those are distractions that we all could have. Distractions are everywhere just waiting. Every corner you turn around, there’s some distractions waiting for you, and if you don’t keep going, they’ll get you. He was distracted all the time by his ego. But he was the guy that was always trying to learn. He was always playing the vibes, and he was listening to the other guys,…
Why did you leave the band?
